paper_title: SepLLM Accelerate Large Language Models by Compressing One Segment into   One Separator
caption: Training loss curves for the post-training setting.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the training loss across iterations for several models. The x-axis is labeled "#Iteration" and spans from 95000 to 125000 iterations on a linear scale, with tick labels displayed every 10000 iterations. The y-axis is labeled "Loss" and ranges from 2.0 to 3.0 on a linear scale. A dashed red line is present across the plot at a value of 2.3. The first line, colored magenta, uses a circular marker and a solid line style, beginning at a value of 2.94 at 95000 iterations, decreasing to 2.25 at 125000 iterations. The second line, colored blue, uses a circular marker and a solid line style, starting at 2.89 at 95000 iterations and declining to 2.24 at 125000 iterations. The third line, colored orange, uses a circular marker and a solid line style, commencing at 2.86 at 95000 iterations and falling to 2.24 at 125000 iterations. Lastly, the fourth line, colored red, is displayed as a dashed line and a solid marker, is horizontal, with a value of 2.3 across the entire range of the x-axis.
